title: Microsoft Entra ID Configuration Template for FantumBudget
description: This template documents the expected Entra ID configuration structure for appsettings.json files in Budget.Web and Budget.Api projects

AzureAd._comment_Instance: The Azure AD instance. Use global endpoint for commercial cloud. For other clouds, see: https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity-platform/authentication-national-cloud
AzureAd._comment_Domain: Your Azure AD tenant domain. Find this in Azure Portal -> Azure Active Directory -> Overview -> Primary domain
AzureAd._comment_TenantId: Your Azure AD tenant ID (GUID). Find in Azure Portal -> Azure Active Directory -> Overview -> Tenant ID. Example: 12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012
AzureAd._comment_ClientId: Application (client) ID from your app registration. Find in Azure Portal -> App registrations -> FantumBudget -> Overview. Example: 87654321-4321-4321-4321-210987654321
AzureAd._comment_ClientSecret: The client secret value generated in Azure Portal. IMPORTANT: Store this securely in Azure Key Vault for production. Never commit to source control!
AzureAd._comment_CallbackPath: The path where the identity provider will redirect after authentication. Must match redirect URI configured in app registration.
AzureAd._comment_SignedOutCallbackPath: The path where the identity provider will redirect after sign-out.
AzureAd._comment_ResponseType: OAuth 2.0 response type. 'code' uses authorization code flow (recommended for web apps).
AzureAd._comment_SaveTokens: Whether to save access and refresh tokens in the authentication cookie. Set to true to enable token refresh.
AzureAd._comment_Scope: Space-separated list of scopes to request. These must match permissions configured in app registration.

KeyVault._comment_VaultUri: Azure Key Vault URI for storing secrets. Recommended for production environments. Example: https://fantumbudget-kv.vault.azure.net/

Admin.Name: Admin
Admin._comment_Admin: Administrator role with full access. Assigned in Azure Portal -> Enterprise applications -> FantumBudget -> Users and groups

PowerUser.Name: PowerUser
PowerUser._comment_PowerUser: Power User role with elevated access to advanced features

User.Name: User
User._comment_User: Standard user role with basic access to core features

LogLevel._comment_Authentication: Set to 'Debug' for detailed authentication logs during troubleshooting

AzureAd._comment_TenantId: Your Azure AD tenant ID. Should match the tenant ID used in Budget.Web
AzureAd._comment_ClientId: Application (client) ID. Same as Budget.Web if using the same app registration, or different if using a separate API app registration
AzureAd._comment_Audience: Expected audience for JWT tokens. Format: api://{ClientId}. Used for token validation in the API.
AzureAd._comment_ValidateAudience: Whether to validate the audience claim in JWT tokens. Should be true for production.
AzureAd._comment_ValidateIssuer: Whether to validate the issuer claim in JWT tokens. Should be true for production.
AzureAd._comment_ValidateLifetime: Whether to validate token expiration. Should be true for production.
AzureAd._comment_ClockSkew: Maximum allowed clock skew in seconds when validating token expiration. Default is 300 seconds (5 minutes).

RequireAdminRole._comment: Policy requiring Admin role. Use with [Authorize(Policy = "RequireAdminRole")]

RequirePowerUserRole._comment: Policy requiring Admin or PowerUser role. Use with [Authorize(Policy = "RequirePowerUserRole")]

RequireAuthenticatedUser._comment: Policy requiring any authenticated user with a role. Use with [Authorize(Policy = "RequireAuthenticatedUser")]

LogLevel._comment_Authorization: Set to 'Debug' for detailed authorization logs

SharedConfiguration._comment: Common configuration notes applicable to both Budget.Web and Budget.Api

Development._note: For local development, you can store ClientSecret directly in appsettings.Development.json (not committed to source control via .gitignore)

Staging._note: For staging environment, use Azure Key Vault for secrets and Azure Container Apps URLs

Production._note: For production environment, ALWAYS use Azure Key Vault for secrets

SecurityBestPractices.1_ClientSecret: NEVER commit client secrets to source control. Use Azure Key Vault in production.
SecurityBestPractices.2_HTTPS: ALWAYS use HTTPS in production. Entra ID requires HTTPS for redirect URIs (except localhost).
SecurityBestPractices.3_TokenValidation: ALWAYS validate tokens in the API: issuer, audience, lifetime, and signature.
SecurityBestPractices.4_RoleBasedAccess: Use role-based authorization policies to control access to features.
SecurityBestPractices.5_SecretRotation: Rotate client secrets regularly (before expiration) and update Key Vault.
SecurityBestPractices.6_Monitoring: Enable logging for authentication and authorization events. Monitor for failures.
SecurityBestPractices.7_MFA: Consider enforcing MFA through Conditional Access policies for sensitive roles.
SecurityBestPractices.8_ScopeMinimization: Only request the minimum scopes needed. Don't request unnecessary permissions.

TokenFlow._description: How authentication tokens flow in the application
TokenFlow.Step1: User authenticates with Entra ID via Budget.Web
TokenFlow.Step2: Entra ID returns ID token and access token to Budget.Web
TokenFlow.Step3: Budget.Web stores tokens in authentication cookie
TokenFlow.Step4: Budget.Web includes access token in API requests to Budget.Api
TokenFlow.Step5: Budget.Api validates the access token and extracts user claims (including roles)
TokenFlow.Step6: Budget.Api authorizes the request based on user roles and policies

RoleClaims.Example: User claims will include: { "role": "Admin" } or { "role": ["Admin", "PowerUser"] } for multi-role users
RoleClaims.Usage: Access roles in code via: User.IsInRole("Admin") or [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]

AppRoles.Description: Power User role with elevated access

AADSTS50011_ReplyUrlMismatch.Error: The reply URL specified in the request does not match the reply URLs configured for the application
AADSTS50011_ReplyUrlMismatch.Solution: Verify CallbackPath in appsettings.json matches exactly with redirect URI in Azure Portal. Check protocol (http/https) and port number.

AADSTS65001_ConsentRequired.Error: The user or administrator has not consented to use the application
AADSTS65001_ConsentRequired.Solution: Grant admin consent for API permissions in Azure Portal -> App registrations -> API permissions

AADSTS700016_UnauthorizedClient.Error: Application not found in the directory
AADSTS700016_UnauthorizedClient.Solution: Verify ClientId in appsettings.json matches the Application ID in Azure Portal. Check that you're using the correct tenant.

InvalidClientSecret.Solution: Verify the client secret in appsettings.json or Key Vault is correct and not expired. Create a new secret if needed.

RoleNotAssigned.Error: User authenticated but doesn't have expected permissions
RoleNotAssigned.Solution: Assign user to a role in Azure Portal -> Enterprise applications -> FantumBudget -> Users and groups
